in_game_description: Stealth generators can hide a ship from prying eyes almost completely. It lasts for a short time and is useful for sneaking up on enemies or quickly escaping dangerous situations. The Sight Suppressor II is an entry level model.
mechanics_text: For two energy cells, a ship can turn invisible in 6.5 seconds (loading_speed=6500ms) and remain so for 20 seconds (duration=20000ms).
While invisible, no other pilots can track your ship, stopping all fire.
Despite long charging time, has double the cloak duration of the U'tool.

gof2_hd_overrides._note: GoF2 HD Android single source at Ni'mrrod only, same price at min and max.

version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect=20000ms = CLOAK DURATION, not a multiplier. GoF2 HD Android has only one station (Ni'mrrod at $65,146).
